# {{ site.person.name }}

> {{ site.person.name }} is a {{ site.person.job_title | downcase }} with 9+ years building first-of-their-kind products in regulated, high-stakes industries: energy, pharma, cybersecurity and enterprise SaaS. Earlier career in print and branding as an art director, including in-house book cover design at Health Communications, Inc. (publisher of Chicken Soup for the Soul). Currently also offers book cover design for independent authors and small presses.
